articles.summary: SBA Communications Corporation (Nasdaq: SBAC) ("SBA" or the "Company") today reported results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Highlights of the third quarter include: Net income attributable to SBA of $231.3 million or $2.19 per share Industry-leading AFFO per share of $3.19 Repurchased 1.7 million shares throughout the quarter Established a $2.5 billion commercial paper program Sold all towers in Chile and Ecuador and entered into an agreement to sell all towers in Peru In addition, the Company announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $1.25 per share of the Company’s Class A Common Stock. articles.title: SBA Communications Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results; Updates Full Year 2026 Outlook; and Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend
